bullets.id: Emas memantul tajam pada Jumat: Trading Economics mencatat emas naik 2,16% ke $3.644, sementara Journalarta mencatat penutupan $3.652 dengan rentang harian $3.558–$3.686. Pantulan ini datang setelah emas menyentuh level terendah 15 bulan di dekat $3.427 awal pekan. Short covering menjelang libur AS dan membaiknya permintaan fisik di China dan India ikut mendorong kenaikan.
bullets.en: Gold bounced sharply on Friday: Trading Economics shows gold up 2.16% at $3,644, while Journalarta records a $3,652 close with a $3,558–$3,686 daily range. The bounce came after gold touched a 15-month low near $3,427 earlier in the week. Short covering ahead of the US holiday and improving physical demand in China and India helped drive the gain.

bullets.id: Latar belakangnya masih ketat. Core PCE Oktober naik 3,3% secara tahunan dan PDB kuartal III AS direvisi ke 4,3%, sehingga pasar memperkirakan kenaikan suku bunga Fed 25 bps pada Desember hampir pasti, dengan kemungkinan kenaikan lagi pada Januari. Yield 10 tahun AS di dekat 4,94% dan dolar dekat level tertinggi 22 bulan. Emas masih turun sekitar 10,4% dalam sebulan dan sekitar 35% di bawah rekor $5.608 pada Januari.
bullets.en: The backdrop is still tight. October core PCE rose 3.3% year on year and US Q3 GDP was revised to 4.3%, so markets see a 25 bp Fed hike in December as near-certain, with a possible further hike in January. The US 10-year yield is near 4.94% and the dollar is close to a 22-month high. Gold is still down about 10.4% on the month and about 35% below its $5,608 January record.

bullets.id: Level yang diamati: high Jumat di dekat $3.686 sebagai resistance terdekat, lalu low pekan ini di dekat $3.427 sebagai support. Pasar emas tutup akhir pekan dan dibuka lagi Senin, 30 November, pukul 06.00 WIB. Trader akan mencermati arah dolar, sinyal Fed menjelang rapat Desember, dan permintaan China, termasuk dampak usulan tarif baru AS 20% atas impor China.
bullets.en: Levels in focus: Friday’s high near $3,686 as nearest resistance, then this week’s low near $3,427 as support. The gold market is closed for the weekend and reopens Monday, November 30, at 6:00 a.m. WIB. Traders will watch the dollar, Fed signals ahead of the December meeting, and China demand, including the impact of a proposed new 20% US tariff on Chinese imports.

bullets.id: Antam 1 gram naik Rp13.000 ke Rp2.514.000 dan buyback naik Rp4.000 ke Rp2.171.000, sehingga spread Rp343.000 (sekitar 13,6%), lebih sempit dari Rp408.000 pada Rabu. Galeri24 dijual Rp2.356.000 dengan buyback Rp2.216.000 (spread sekitar 5,9%), dan UBS Rp2.378.000 dengan buyback Rp2.192.000 (sekitar 7,8%).
bullets.en: Antam’s 1-gram bar rose Rp13,000 to Rp2,514,000 and buyback rose Rp4,000 to Rp2,171,000, leaving a Rp343,000 spread (about 13.6%), narrower than Rp408,000 on Wednesday. Galeri24 sells at Rp2,356,000 with a Rp2,216,000 buyback (a spread of about 5.9%), and UBS at Rp2,378,000 with a Rp2,192,000 buyback (about 7.8%).
